name: Balikbayan SMP
description:
Our server aims to be a peaceful place to unwind after a long day at school or work—a world where you can relax, have fun, and enjoy Minecraft with friends or other players. Sounds like your kind of community? Come join us! At Balikbayan, everyone has access to our features. Donations help support the server without giving anyone an unfair gameplay advantage, while our Donator Rank and Cosmetic Bundles remain affordable. Come relax, have fun, and be part of our simple community!

Vanilla Gameplay - Enjoy gameplay close to vanilla Minecraft.

Anti-Cheat - Advanced protection which prevents most players cheating activities.

Grief Protection - Protect containers, entities, and important blocks.

Land Claim - Claim and expand your land to protect it from griefing.

PVP toggle - Turn PVP off whenever you want for peaceful gameplay.

Resource World - A separate resource world that resets weekly.

Clan System - Create or join clans and build bonds.

Voice Chat - Proximity voice chat for in-game communication.

Vaults - Portable storage separate from your Ender Chest.

Economy - Multiple currencies for trading and purchasing in-game items.

Auction - Buy and sell items in the Auction.

Player Shops - Set up shops in the Shopping District.

Player Trading - Trade items directly with other players.

Capturable Pets - Capture and summon vanilla mobs as companions or helpers.

Dungeons - Fight modified vanilla mobs, bosses, and mini-bosses for Gems and Peso.

Pure Cosmetics - Cosmetic items with no pay-to-win advantages.

Donator Perks - Quality-of-life perks for server supporters.

Donator Cosmetics - Cosmetic bundles (complete armor, weapons, and tools) for server supporters.

Vote Crates - Earn points, and weapon cosmetics by voting.

Holiday Crates - Earn special crates during major holidays.

Duels - Enjoy optional Kit PVP for group or 1v1 battles.
